source_snapshot.items: GFX Stress – rocBLAS Based Workload - AGFHC Max Power
source_snapshot.procedure: Run AGFHC gfx_maxpower while a separate amd-smi monitor -w 5 collects every GPU's utilization and power.
source_snapshot.criteria: AGFHC success, no miscompare and no dmesg failure; explicit FAIL for AGFHC failure, miscompare or error during the test window.
source_snapshot.bundle: No bundle; ten attended and ten machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL and supplies workload plus monitor through insecure SSH, but lacks per-GPU mapping, power/thermal limits, complete monitor lifetime/integrity, baseline RAS/error deltas and recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires adequate cooling, approved rocBLAS recipe, independent full-window per-GPU monitoring and bounded high-power operation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Covers both nominal commands and flags high heat, but leaves the quantitative envelope, identity/completeness and system-error acceptance undefined.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds per-GPU identity, approved limits, adequate cooling, timestamped baseline/post RAS/system evidence, monitor-failure invalidation and recovery.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-07/08 preserve evidence; ED-11/12 gate stress/retry; ED-36/38 govern identity, logs and verdict.

original_test_intent: Drive the intended AMD GPUs with the rocBLAS-based AGFHC maximum-power workload while measuring each device, and prove success/no miscompare without exceeding the approved power/thermal envelope or generating new hardware/system errors.
original_method: Bind live GPU identities to approved AGFHC and AMD-SMI versions, gfx_maxpower recipe and platform power/cooling limits; capture baseline health/RAS/logs, confirm dedicated no-load conditions and start a verified timestamped per-GPU monitor at five-second cadence; run once under approval, preserve complete workload and monitor evidence, evaluate success/miscompare and every device's utilization/power/temperature, then compare post-test errors and health without clearing logs.
manual_activity: The owner approves recipe, device map, quantitative envelope and dedicated/cooling conditions; an operator watches every GPU throughout the run; the owner evaluates performance/health/errors and decides the verdict.
required_inputs: SUT/GPU topology and stable device-index map
Approved AGFHC gfx_maxpower and AMD-SMI/amdsmi versions/checksums
Per-GPU power, temperature, utilization and cooling limits
Dedicated no-load maintenance, five-second monitor requirements, aborts and recovery
safety_requirements: Require explicit approval and verified cooling/power headroom before max-power stress
Use protected access and preserve complete output/exit status
Start/verify independent per-GPU monitor before workload and retain full window
Preserve baseline/post logs instead of clearing them
Monitor all GPUs for thermal/power/utilization/health/RAS and system stability
Stop on limit, failure, miscompare, new error, GPU loss or monitor gap
Do not retry after unexplained high-power anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Collect tool/device identities, quantitative envelope and baselines
Validate monitor coverage/cadence and workload recipe
After approval run workload once with full independent monitoring
Parse success/miscompare and per-GPU/test-window health deltas
Perform no limit invention, uncontrolled stress, recovery or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve tools/recipe, GPU map, cooling and power/thermal/error limits
Disposition any limit/error/miscompare/coverage anomaly and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It includes the two required commands but insecurely and without proving monitor startup/lifetime, per-GPU identity, approved limits, baseline deltas or full evidence integrity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Start a validated identity-bound five-second monitor, then execute the approved gfx_maxpower recipe once on a cooled dedicated SUT and reconcile complete workload, per-GPU envelope and error-delta evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: agfhc -t gfx_maxpower, amd-smi monitor -w 5, success/no-miscompare/no-dmesg-error criteria, no bundle and 10/10-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize rocBLAS workload phases with five-second per-GPU utilization/power/temperature/RAS samples and test-window system logs under an approved cooling envelope.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds quantitative limits, stable GPU identity and monitor integrity without changing the two source commands or criteria.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A workload success plus partial monitor output can miss an unmonitored GPU, transient limit excursion or new hardware error.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A maximum-power workload can saturate rack/platform delivery and cooling, and monitor gaps invalidate the ability to prove the envelope was respected.

project_override_considerations: If amd-smi monitor does not expose temperature or stable device identity, supplement it with an approved compatible read-only collector; do not reduce per-GPU or full-window coverage. Platform/rack limits must be approved, not inferred from observed peaks.
expected_evidence: Approved tool/recipe/device-map identities, power/thermal/cooling/utilization limits and dedicated approval
Baseline GPU/RAS/kernel/BMC/thermal/power health and verified monitor startup
Complete identity-bound five-second per-GPU utilization/power/temperature stream and limit comparison
Post error/health delta, no-clear/no-secret/no-retry audit, recovery record and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source asks to clear logs and gives qualitative max-power acceptance without numeric power/thermal/cooling limits, device map or monitor-integrity rules. DeepSeek uses invalid PARTIAL/insecure dual SSH and omits baseline RAS/system deltas and bounded recovery.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; compatible tools, device map, quantitative limits, adequate cooling, dedicated window, monitoring and recovery are supplyable inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2063 Wistron-AMD SVM-00017-V002: approve AGFHC gfx_maxpower and AMD-SMI versions, live GPU index/identity map, documented success/miscompare semantics, per-GPU power/temperature/utilization plus platform cooling limits, baseline-to-post RAS/system-error policy, dedicated window, aborts and recovery.

review_improvement: Turns the nominal two-command flow into a complete per-GPU high-power envelope and integrity qualification with preserved error evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Max-power acceptance is not just whether AGFHC exits successfully: each intended GPU must be observed for the entire run because one device can exceed limits or drop while aggregate work continues. A five-second stream needs stable identity, timestamps and gap detection. Miscompare and RAS/system-error deltas address computational and hardware integrity separately from power/thermal compliance. Quantitative limits are platform-owned and cannot be derived from a single observed run.
